material.source: Same trial elastic modulus as Step 2B; not material selection

boundary: Uy=0 everywhere (plane strain). At x=0 prescribe exact ux and uz including cross-section warping; NOT a rigid clamp. Top/bottom free. End x=L has consistent traction integrated with 3x3 surface Gauss rule. No body force. This is not the free-sided curved TS-C bay.

load_sensitivity.mapping: Equal force at every x=L node; same resultant and first moment, different traction distribution; never score as exact-solution error

units: m, kN, kPa; tension positive; physical shear stress

qa_declared_before_solving.scope: Accuracy targets against independent exact field for consistent-traction coupons only; all six stress RMS targets plus tip/energy. Not code capacity or module convergence.
